Wants explicit burst buffer allowing up to 2x committed throughput for 7 days/month without immediate throttling; proposed overage at 1.25x committed unit rate but finance expects 1.1x. Asks for 30% discount off list pricing for 12-month commit and SKU-based pricing per model family. Also requested a 60-day rollback option if performance regression in quality or latency >20%.

Model preference: open Llama-family variant or Redwood-verified quantized models; fallbacks to smaller model for degraded capacity. KV/prefix caching required. Must integrate with existing SSO (SAML) and KMS for key management. Audit logs retention 1 year. EU residency for logs and inference metadata.
